Theorem
[Ruled-cylinder area estimate] 1. 9.3.1\group thurston.ch09.endingSource: thurston:page-0249 A ruled cylinder spanning homotopic closed geodesics has area bounded above by the sum of the lengths of its boundary curves.
Proof

\sketch Rule the cylinder by geodesic segments and compare the induced Jacobi-field lengths; integrating the convexity estimate gives the boundary-length bound.

□
